ETHICS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 25, 2023
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:30 PM

Margo Morales, Chair  Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner
Barbara A. Pollack, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Susan Wise, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 5:34 PM, Chair Morales called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Añorve, De Benedictis, Shotwell, Wise, Pollack, Morales

 Also present: April Walker, Administrative Deputy City Manager, Heather Van Wijk, Ethics Officer,
 Jorge Godinez, Assistant to the City Manager, Taylor Anderson, Deputy City Attorney,
 Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Specialist.

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  23-24674  Recommendation to receive and file public input regarding proposed changes to
  the City’s lobbyist ordinance; and if appropriate, provide feedback to the Ad Hoc
  Committee on next steps regarding a recommendation to the City Council.

  A motion was made by Commissioner De Benedictis, seconded by
  Commissioner Añorve, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Añorve, De Benedictis, Shotwell, Wise, Pollack, Morales
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None
